en-US.title: NetworkOS - Private CRM
en-US.subtitle: Remember people that matter
en-US.description:
Your network. Organized.

NetworkOS is a private, local-first CRM for the people who matter to you. No account. No server. Your data stays encrypted on your device.

KEY FEATURES:
• Private contacts — photos, notes, job titles, birthdays and relationship strength in one calm place
• A private vault — mark anyone private and they vanish from lists, search, the graph and every export until you unlock it
• Merge duplicates and a real trash — nothing is lost to a mistaken tap
• See the thread — a visual network graph you can rewind to see how your network looked a year ago
• Goals that count themselves — "talk to 5 investors this quarter", measured from interactions you actually logged
• Follow through — follow-ups, commitments, meetings, and birthday reminders so you never miss a move
• Companies, tags & search — organize by company, tag, city, and importance; find anyone fast
• Import from phone — optionally import from iOS Contacts, and let NetworkOS quietly keep those people current if you turn on phone book sync. Off by default, read-only, and it never adds anyone on its own
• Network insights — see who is your only route to whom, which clusters never meet, and which strong ties have gone quiet
• Introductions worth making — automatic suggestions for people in your network who should meet, with a ready-to-send message
• Meeting briefings — matches your calendar to your contacts on device and briefs you 30 minutes before
• Sync your own devices — carry an encrypted bundle between iPhone and iPad by AirDrop. Still no server, still no account
• Encrypted backup — protected by a recovery key you hold, so it opens on a new phone too; CSV export is clearly marked unencrypted
• App lock — optional Face ID / Touch ID lock; database key stays in Secure Enclave-backed SecureStore
• English + Türkçe — full bilingual experience

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Local-first SQLite, encrypted on device. Contacts access is optional and never leaves your phone. No analytics SDK, no ads, no tracking.

WHO IT'S FOR
Founders, freelancers, salespeople, job-seekers, and anyone who wants a quiet, reliable memory for relationships.

Download NetworkOS and keep the people who matter close enough to act on.
en-US.releaseNotes:
NetworkOS 1.2.1

• Home opens on the day's work now: who is due, birthdays coming up, promises to keep. Each row acts where it stands — snooze or mark contacted without leaving the screen
• Text that was hard to read in dark mode is fixed
• Forms no longer leave the field you are typing in behind the keyboard
• Layout follows each device's own safe area instead of one fixed measurement
• The last English label left in the Turkish interface is translated

Coming from 1.0, this update also carries everything in 1.2: the sign-in loop is gone and your data is encrypted on device, Contacts import works again, you can navigate back from Companies, and phone book sync fills blank fields on people you already imported.
en-US.promoText: Private, local-first CRM. No account, no cloud — your people stay on your device.

tr.title: NetworkOS - Özel CRM
tr.subtitle: Önemli kişileri hatırla
tr.description:
Ağınız. Düzenli.

NetworkOS, önem verdiğiniz kişiler için özel, cihaz-içi (local-first) bir CRM'dir. Hesap yok. Sunucu yok. Verileriniz şifreli olarak cihazınızda kalır.

ÖNE ÇIKANLAR:
• Özel kişiler — fotoğraf, not, unvan, doğum günü ve ilişki gücü tek sakin yerde
• Gizli kasa — birini gizli işaretleyin; kasayı açana kadar listelerden, aramadan, grafikten ve tüm dışa aktarımlardan kaybolsun
• Kopyaları birleştirin, çöp kutusundan geri yükleyin — yanlış bir dokunuş hiçbir şeyi götürmesin
• Bağlantıyı görün — geri sarılabilir ağ grafiği: ağınız bir yıl önce nasıldı, görün
• Kendini sayan hedefler — "bu çeyrek 5 yatırımcıyla konuş", gerçekten kaydettiğiniz etkileşimlerden ölçülür
• Takipte kalın — takip hatırlatmaları, sözler, görüşmeler ve doğum günleri; hamlenizi kaçırmayın
• Şirketler, etiketler ve arama — şirket, etiket, şehir ve öneme göre düzenleyin
• Telefondan içe aktar — isterseniz iOS Kişiler'den aktarın; rehber senkronunu açarsanız aktardığınız kişiler sessizce güncel kalır. Varsayılan kapalı, yalnızca okur, kimseyi kendiliğinden eklemez
• Ağ içgörüleri — kime yalnızca kimin üzerinden ulaştığınızı, hiç buluşmayan kümeleri ve sessizleşen güçlü bağları görün
• Yapmaya değer tanıştırmalar — birbirini tanıması gereken kişiler için otomatik öneri ve hazır mesaj
• Görüşme brifingi — takviminizi cihaz içinde kişilerinizle eşleştirir, görüşmeden 30 dakika önce hatırlatır
• Kendi cihazlarınız arasında eşitleme — şifreli paketi AirDrop ile taşıyın. Yine sunucu yok, yine hesap yok
• Şifreli yedek — sizde duran kurtarma anahtarıyla korunur; yeni telefonda da açılır
• Uygulama kilidi — isteğe bağlı Face ID / Touch ID kilidi
• İngilizce + Türkçe — tam iki dilli deneyim

GİZLİLİK ÖNCELİKLİ
Cihaz-içi şifreli SQLite. Kişiler erişimi isteğe bağlıdır ve telefonunuzdan çıkmaz. Reklam yok, takip yok.

NetworkOS'u indirin ve önem verdiğiniz kişileri yakın tutun.
tr.releaseNotes:

tr.promoText: Özel, cihaz-içi CRM. Hesap yok, bulut yok — kişileriniz cihazınızda kalır.

review.notes:
No login / no demo account needed — app is local-first and opens directly to onboarding (first/last name only, stored on device).

This build is a UI refinement over 1.2.0, which you approved on 15 September. No new permissions, no new data collection, no new third-party code. The changes are layout, contrast and copy: the Home screen leads with what is due, dark-mode text contrast is corrected, forms avoid the keyboard, and safe-area insets come from the device instead of a fixed value.

How to review:
1. Enter any first name on onboarding, tap Start — no network call.
2. Home > + adds a contact manually. Contacts access is OPTIONAL and has two entry points, both user-initiated: tapping Import (More > Import contacts), and the toggle under More > Phone book sync, which is OFF by default and is the only thing that turns on automatic refreshing. Enabling it asks for the contacts permission once; afterwards the app reads (never writes) the address book at most every 15 minutes to fill in blank fields on contacts the user already imported. It never adds contacts on its own and nothing leaves the device.
3. Network tab: select a person to see local graph (depth 2). Needs 2+ contacts with a relationship to render edges — otherwise empty state is expected.
4. Follow-up tab: set next_follow_up_at on a contact to see reminder row.
5. More > Security: biometric lock is OPTIONAL; safe to skip on simulator.
6. More > Backup: encrypted backup export is on-device; CSV export shows an unencrypted warning by design.

Permissions:
- NSContactsUsageDescription: optional import only.
- NSFaceIDUsageDescription: optional app lock only.
- No tracking, no ads, no third-party SDKs.

Support: support@networkos.app — privacy policy https://ermixserdar.github.io/networkos/privacy
